title: Igagasi Elahlula Igazi
intro: Khawucinge ngomkhukula omkhulu onyuka phezu komhlaba, iTyeya idada izinzile, kwaye umphefumlo omnye ushiywe ngaphandle ngokuzithandela. Ebotshelelwe ligazi kumprofeti kodwa owahlulwe lukholo, lo mntu wajongana nobizo lokugqibela lokuba eze emkhombeni njengoko amanzi ayenyuka. Ungayifumana into ebangela ukwala?
clues: Ndingumzukulwana womnye wabaprofeti abakhulu baka-Allah, indlu yokholo endakhetha ukuyishiya.
Ndandiphila ngexesha likaMkhukula Omkhulu, xa ukungakholelwa kwagubungela umhlaba njengamanzi.
Andizange ndivume ukukhwela iTyeya kunye namakholwa xa utata wandibiza.
Ndithe ndiza kubalekela entabeni ukuze ndikhuseleke emanzini.
Ndaxelelwa ukuba akukho nto inokukhusela kwisigqibo sika-Allah ngaloo Mhla ngaphandle kwenceba.
Ndafunyanwa ngamaza ndaza ndarhaxwa, utata waxelelwa ukuba andingowosapho lwakhe olulungileyo.

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
